title: Horten flying wing aircraft on the ground, taped-in print (Fig. 1)
description: Taped-in photographic print of a Horten tailless flying wing aircraft resting on the ground in front of a building, viewed along its swept wing. Typed text above notes the Horten 229 twin-jet fighter had reached final stages by the end of World War II and that a Horten glider prototype soared to 14,200 feet as early as 1938. Captioned "Fig. 1"; stamped CONFIDENTIAL.
